articleHeadline: Altnv Alert: All about the new tick-borne virus.
articleSummary:
- Altnv, a newly identified tick-borne nairovirus (Asian longhorned tick nairovirus), was detected in China. Virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco reassures there is no current global health emergency; there is no evidence of Altnv circulation or specific risk to the Italian population, based on a study in the New England Journal of Medicine. articleHeadline: Opinion | How the melting glaciers are unlocking ancient superbugs we've never seen before
articleSummary: Glacial melt in the Hindu Kush Himalaya (HKH) and adjacent regions is releasing ancient pathogens into modern watersheds. A 30,000-year-old Siberian permafrost yielded a vancomycin-resistance gene, showing long-standing antibiotic resistance potential. articleHeadline: Ghana records over 13,000 new HIV infections-GAC
articleSummary: Ghana recorded 13,795 new HIV infections in 2026, with the Bono Region alone reporting over 1,000 cases this year. Ghana AIDS Commission Director General Dr. Kharmacelle Prosper Akanbong described HIV as a public health threat but a manageable chronic condition, urging widespread use of PrEP and PEP for at‑risk populations and continued access to condoms. He warned against stigmatization of People Living with HIV (PLwH) and urged concerted efforts to reduce transmission. The figures were disclosed during a two-day workshop in Abesim (near Sunyani) on strengthening legal assistance in HIV and TB service provision, organized by GAC in collaboration with CHRAJ and supported by UNAIDS and the Global Fund. The campaign aims to roll out intensified, stigma‑focused HIV/TB interventions nationwide, across southern, middle, and northern zones, engaging legal practitioners, traditional leaders, law enforcement, educators, and civil society.
